verdict.rationale: Rive's own docs describe the elements this story asks for: keyframed animation with interpolation, interaction that responds to scrolling and app state, state machines, and data-bound view models that act as variables. All of it is described only at overview level, and the product is framed as shipping 'the real thing' rather than as a prototyping tool, so depth for each element is unproven. Missing for 10: detailed docs on state-machine transitions and conditional logic, specifics on scroll-driven effects, and independent hands-on confirmation of prototyping use.

support.subject: As a designer, prototypes can carry advanced behavior — animation between states, conditions or variables, scroll effects — to feel like the real product

citations.quote: Build interactive experiences that respond to user input, screen size, scrolling, and application state.
